description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What are the next occurrences of this RFC 5545 recurrence rule? Next N (max 50) UTC occurrences of an RFC 5545 RRULE from a UTC DTSTART, computed locally for a documented subset (FREQ DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYMONTH, BYMONTHDAY, BYDAY, BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, BYSECOND, BYSETPOS, WKST). Unsupported parts return an error, not a guess. UTC only; no time-zone handling. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

after.description: UTC instant to start after (default: now)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: rrule_next
title: RRULE next occurrences (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
